description: Add an `agro workspace` verb that owns host workspace lifecycle, and stop `agro harness install` and `agro tool install` from creating workspaces.

userStories.title: Host workspace listing and resolve-or-refuse helper
userStories.description: As an operator, I want one helper that lists host workspaces and one that resolves an existing workspace or refuses, so that every host verb reaches the same door.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `listHostWorkspaces(env, home)` to `.agro/cli/src/lib/host-workspace.ts`; it scans `workspacesRoot()` from `host-config.ts`, keeps directories matching `SANDBOX_NAME_PATTERN`, and requires a `.git` marker in each child
Add `resolveExistingWorkspace(...)` to the same file; it returns the resolved root, or a refusal string naming `${bin} workspace create` and every workspace that exists
No import cycle is introduced between `host-workspace.ts` and `host-config.ts`
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: `agro workspace` command module
userStories.description: As an operator, I want `workspace create` and `workspace list` implemented as a command module, so that creating a workspace no longer requires installing a harness.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `.agro/cli/src/commands/workspace.ts` exporting `WorkspaceIO`, `WorkspaceOptions`, `runWorkspaceCreate`, and `runWorkspaceList`
`runWorkspaceCreate` runs `assertWorkspaceName`, `stateHomeRefusal`, `stateHomeRootRefusal`, and `ensureHostWorkspace`, and honors `--path <dir>`
`runWorkspaceCreate` never writes `harnessRoot` to the host config
`runWorkspaceList` marks the recorded default and supports `--json` via `JSON.stringify(x, null, 2)`
An empty registry prints a hint naming `${bin} workspace create`
Conventions match `commands/harness.ts`: injected `io.stdout`/`io.stderr`, injectable `LifecycleRunner`, `renderTable`, numeric exit codes, `${bin} workspace: ` error prefix
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Wire the verb into the CLI dispatcher
userStories.description: As an operator, I want `agro workspace` dispatched and documented in help, so that the verb is discoverable from the front door.
acceptanceCriteria: `printOhHelp` in `.agro/cli/src/cli.ts` carries one `workspace` usage line
`printWorkspaceHelp(bin)` documents both subcommands
`parseWorkspaceArgs` accepts `--json`, `--path <v>`, `--path=<v>`, and one positional name, and rejects `--path` together with a positional name
An `if (first === "workspace")` branch dispatches above the compose-verb branch at `cli.ts:1365`
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Decouple workspace creation from harness install and tool install
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the install verbs to resolve a workspace rather than create one, so that workspace creation and harness installation are separate concerns.
acceptanceCriteria: Delete the `Workspace name [default]:` prompt at `commands/harness.ts:396-403` and the `ensureHostWorkspace` block at `:412-424`
Delete the `Harness root [<root>]:` prompt at `commands/tool.ts:437-439` and the `ensureHostWorkspace` block at `:446-455`
Both paths call `resolveExistingWorkspace` and return 1 on a refusal
Each refusal names `${bin} workspace create` and lists every workspace that exists
Both files keep the host confirmation, the sticky-root notice, both state-home guards, and their `harnessRoot` writes at `harness.ts:490` and `tool.ts:492`
`! grep -q 'ensureHostWorkspace(' .agro/cli/src/commands/harness.ts .agro/cli/src/commands/tool.ts` exits 0
Now-unused imports are deleted and typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Covers D3. Behavior change; CHANGELOG `### Changed` entry required in US-007.

Create cases cover clone, reuse, `--path`, invalid name, split state home, root-is-state-home, and an unchanged `harnessRoot`

Assert `/^ {2}oh workspace /m` against `printOhHelp`
Add a docs-sync assertion for `docs/lifecycle-commands.md` as a new assertion, because `workspace` is not a compose verb
Update the nine assertions referencing the removed prompts: `harness.test.ts:646,670,699,940,1166,1261,1283` and `tool.test.ts:802,876`
`pnpm test` reports 0 failures
